verdict.rationale: Hightouch's ingestion story is built around SQL/dbt models on data already in the customer's warehouse (hightouch-docs-2, hightouch-docs-23) and its Events product only covers self-instrumented apps/sites/backends via SDKs, HTTP API, or streaming sources like Kafka/Pub/Sub (hightouch-docs-5, hightouch-docs-6, hightouch-docs-41). There is no evidence of connectors that pull data in from third-party cloud apps or SaaS feeds (e.g., Salesforce, ad platforms, support tools) into the warehouse — Hightouch is explicitly a reverse-ETL/activation tool that syncs modeled warehouse data OUT to destinations, not an ingestion tool pulling third-party app data IN.
